title: Origenality Controlled Vocabulary — Relevance
description: Closed four-value classifier answering a single question: how much of this publication is about Origen? It is the P2 filter of the pipeline. It is deliberately independent of quality, of language and of date, and it says nothing about the interest of the work — only about the share of it that concerns Origen. A notice carries exactly one value.
decision_rule: Read the four definitions in order from core to none and take the first that fits. When hesitating between two adjacent values, take the lower one and set needs_review to true.

core.label: Origen is the main object
core.description: The publication is about Origen, one of his works, one of his doctrines, or his direct reception. A reader looking for Origen scholarship would put it on the shelf without hesitation.
indicators: Origen or a work of his in the title
an Origenian doctrine as the subject
an edition or translation of an Origenian text
a monograph or article devoted to his exegesis

partial.label: Origen treated substantially among others

labels.de: Origenes wird substantiell neben anderen behandelt
labels.it: Origene trattato in modo sostanziale tra altri

partial.description: Origen is one of several authors genuinely studied: a chapter of a book, one term of a comparison, one witness in a survey that gives him real space. Not the sole subject, but more than an illustration.
indicators: comparison of Origen with another author
a patristic survey with a section on Origen
a study of a theme across the Fathers where Origen is a principal witness

marginal.label: Origen mentioned only
marginal.description: Origen appears as a reference, an example or a name in a list, without being studied. The publication would lose almost nothing if he were removed.
indicators: a passing citation in a work on another subject
a manual mentioning Origen in one paragraph

none.label: Not about Origen
none.description: Noise from harvesting: homonyms, common nouns mistaken for the name, works by Origen catalogued as works about him, records whose metadata does not allow the question to be answered at all. Use this value whenever the notice gives no positive evidence that Origen is discussed.
indicators: Spanish origen or orígenes as a common noun
the record is a text by Origen rather than a study of him
the metadata is too thin to decide
